part.text:
I couldn't open the Feeds tab. This environment has no way to send taps or clicks to the simulator.

The latest screenshot shows the Bluesky home screen with the "Following" tab selected. The "Feeds ✨" tab is at the top right of the tab bar, roughly in the middle-right of the screen. Tapping it would be the next step.

I checked the available tooling. `xcrun simctl` has no tap or touch subcommand, and `idb`, `idb_companion`, and `applesimutils` aren't installed. The available options are `openurl` for deep links, which doesn't have a route for the Feeds tab that I know of, and an XCTest UI target, which would mean building a test bundle. Both are out of scope for this task.

To finish, someone needs to tap "Feeds ✨" on the device, or install a tap-capable tool such as `idb` so I can do it.
